title: Add Stoicky to video_audio
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Stoicky](https://stoicky.vercel.app) to video_audio
- Stoicky is an AI-powered video automation tool for faceless content creators, it uses pollinations.ai for the Image and text AI inference.

Fixes #13037

gist.headline: Faceless videos, freshly pollinated
gist.blurb: Stoicky joined the video_audio garden. It turns Pollinations image and text inference into an AI-assisted workflow for making faceless video content.
gist.summary: Added Stoicky to the video_audio app catalog, showcasing an AI-powered video automation tool for faceless creators that uses Pollinations image and text inference.
gist.impact: Creators can now discover Stoicky through the Pollinations app catalog and use it as a starting point for automated faceless-video workflows.
gist.visual_concept: Polli helps a cozy retro video workstation produce a sequence of faceless creator clips: a CRT monitor shows a timeline with generated image frames and text captions, while little code-plants grow around it. A friendly monitor robot can hold a clapperboard to represent video automation.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny director beret, arranging generated image frames and caption cards on a retro video-editing timeline; a cheerful CRT monitor robot holds a clapperboard beside blooming code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with simple pixel-font text: 'STOICKY'.
